messages:
Maya: quick flag from today's usability run — column resizing in the endpoints table feels jumpy. when you drag a handle the cells reflow immediately and tooltips pop mid-drag which is jarring. video: https://img.redwood/mock/col-resize.mp4
Owen: saw that. tooltips should suspend while pointerdown on a resize handle. we can add `data-no-tooltip` on the table during drag. also consider showing a thin overlay guide instead of live reflow until mouseup.
Priyanka: overlay guide sounds good for discoverability. for accessibility, keyboard resize uses arrow keys and currently shifts focus to the next cell. focus should stay on the handle and announce the new width via aria-live. propose `aria-live="polite"` updates like "Column width 320 pixels".
Theo: agree on aria-live. small visual nit: resize handle hit area is only 8px; increase to 20px so it's easy on touch. keep the visible line thin but bump padding. CSS snippet: `.col-resize { padding: 8px 6px; margin: -8px; }`
Maya: also, table rows with inline action buttons show tooltips on hover with 300ms delay. during rapid pointer movement those tooltips flicker. can we increase hover delay to 500ms and enable `enterable` tooltips so users can move to the tooltip?
Owen: we use `tippy` lib. default delay is [100, 300]. propose [500, 100] for show/hide so they don't flash during drags but disappear quickly after. will add `onTrigger: (state) => state.reference.closest('.is-resizing') ? false : true` to prevent while resizing.
Priyanka: toast anchoring: small success toasts for row actions are currently injected next to the table container which makes them overlap column headers on narrow screens. prefer global portal anchored to `#app-toast-root` with breakpoint rules: top-right for >720px, bottom-center for <=720px. also ensure toasts don't steal focus (aria-live only).
Theo: migration-wise, we have a few pages still relying on `local-toast` mount. i'll add a runtime fallback to move existing local toasts into the global portal to avoid dupes. test matrix: desktop 1366x768, tablet 768x1024, phone 375x812.
Maya: motion note: when columns resize we animate width easing out over 160ms. for users with `prefers-reduced-motion` we should use step (no animation). also avoid animating layout (use transform overlay guide) to prevent content reflow.
Owen: microcopy: tooltip for the endpoint status currently says "Healthy" or "Unhealthy". maybe add brief hint "Click for details" when status is actionable. keep tooltip text under 50 chars.
Priyanka: accessibility follow-up: ensure the table caption describes interactive behaviors, e.g., "Use drag handles or press Shift+Arrow to resize columns". captions help keyboard-only and screen reader users.
Theo: i'll bundle these into one PR: suspend tooltips during drag, add overlay guide, increase handle hit area, global toast portal with breakpoints, aria-live resize announcements, and reduced-motion checks. will include unit+e2e snapshots.
UxBot: test run queued: col-resize-overlay (pass), tooltip-delay-adjust (pass), toast-portal-breakpoints (pass). snapshot id: c1d8a.
Maya: thanks team — can we also add a tiny note in the component docs about when to use persistent tooltips vs transient hints? helps PMs and content designers. landing this next week would be ideal. :raised_hands:
